name: Yeomen
headerMeta: Heroic era · Cavalry · 225 leadership · Honor Tree
pitch: A lancer cavalry unit whose whole kit is about buying enough room to reach max charge speed before impact — rush the charge and it does nothing special. Guidance here predates the current patch and no source gives this unit a counters write-up, so treat matchups as your own read of the fight.

doctrines.name: Lancer-Last Stand

doctrines.name: Epic Charge Defence Doctrine

veterancy.label: Top Line
veterancy.body: Everything works on this unit, but start here.

battleRole.positioning: Like any lancer cavalry, hold approach until there's enough room to reach max speed before impact — commit late, not early. {1}
battleRole.tips: Run the rune that speeds up the lancer-cav trait cycle from every 1.5s to every 0.5s (if still available), so the long-charge trait loads much faster. {1} Once at max speed, an X-move to a side still carries enough momentum for huge damage — a smaller version of the Xuanjia trick. {1}
